categories.name: Mobility & Tissue Capacity
categories.description: Foundational layer - assess joint mobility and tissue capacity
categories.goalDescription: Able to maintain joint position, spinal alignment, and movement quality under gradually increasing load.

tests.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion
tests.description: Knee 5 in (12–13 cm) past toes in knee-to-wall test

tests.name: Hip Internal Rotation
tests.description: Hip internal rotation test - each side

tests.name: Hip External Rotation
tests.description: Hip external rotation test

tests.name: Hip Flexion
tests.description: Hip flexion range of motion

tests.name: Straight Leg Raise
tests.description: Straight leg raise height

tests.name: Shoulder Flexion
tests.description: Arms reach overhead with ribs down (≈170–180°)

tests.name: Thoracic Rotation
tests.description: Thoracic rotation test - each side

tests.name: Thoracic Extension
tests.description: Can reach overhead against wall without compensation

tests.name: Neck Rotation
tests.description: Neck rotation test - each direction

tests.name: Flexion : Extension Ratio
tests.description: Target ratio: ~1.0

tests.name: Side Bridge : Extension Ratio (each side)
tests.description: Target ratio: ~0.75

tests.name: Left : Right Side Bridge Balance
tests.description: Target difference: ≥0.95 ratio

categories.name: Core Stability
categories.description: Can I stabilize my spine? Focus on deep abdominal system.
categories.goalDescription: Ability to stabilize the spine through the deep core system (transverse abdominis, internal/external obliques, multifidus, diaphragm, pelvic floor).

tests.name: Dead Bug
tests.description: 10 slow reps per side, 5 second lowering, zero compensation

tests.name: Front Plank
tests.description: 60 seconds, perfectly straight body, breathing normally, no shaking

tests.name: Side Plank
tests.description: 45 seconds each side, difference between sides <10%

tests.name: Bird Dog
tests.description: 10 repetitions each side, 5-second holds, pelvis absolutely level

tests.name: Supine 90/90 March
tests.description: 20 controlled marches, lumbar spine remains flat

tests.name: Diaphragmatic Breathing
tests.description: 10 slow breaths while maintaining abdominal brace

categories.name: Full Core
categories.description: Can my spine remain stable while arms and legs move?
categories.goalDescription: Spine resists outside forces with dynamic limb movement. Includes erector spinae, quadratus lumborum, thoracolumbar fascia, rotators, and anti-rotation muscles.

tests.name: McGill Curl-Up
tests.description: 10 reps with 10-second holds, no pain, no compensation

tests.name: Sorensen Hold
tests.description: Back extension endurance test - 90 seconds

tests.name: Side Bridge
tests.description: 75 seconds each side, <10% difference between sides

tests.name: Pallof Press
tests.description: 10 presses each direction without rotating

tests.name: Farmer Carry
tests.description: Carry 25% bodyweight each hand for 60 seconds, perfect posture

tests.name: Suitcase Carry
tests.description: Carry 25% bodyweight one side only, 60 seconds without leaning

tests.name: Single-Leg Bridge
tests.description: 20 reps each leg, <10% difference between sides

tests.name: Hip Hinge Test
tests.description: PVC touching head, upper back, sacrum - 20 perfect hinges

categories.name: Trunk Stability
categories.description: Can the hips and shoulders stabilize everything?
categories.goalDescription: Hips, scapulae, thoracic spine, and neck work in harmony to stabilize the trunk during dynamic movement.

tests.name: Single-Leg Balance (Eyes Open)
tests.description: 60 seconds on each leg, eyes open

tests.name: Single-Leg Balance (Eyes Closed)
tests.description: 30 seconds on each leg, eyes closed

tests.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
tests.description: 15 reps each leg without touching opposite foot

tests.name: Step-Down Test
tests.description: 8-inch box, 15 perfect reps each side, knees tracking correctly

tests.name: Y Balance Test
tests.description: Reach difference <4 cm between sides

tests.name: Wall Slide
tests.description: 15 repetitions without rib flare

tests.name: Scapular Push-Ups
tests.description: 20 repetitions with proper scapular control

tests.name: Shoulder External Rotation
tests.description: Band work, 20 reps each side, perfect control

tests.name: Half-Kneeling Chop/Lift
tests.description: 15 reps each direction without trunk movement

tests.name: Goblet Squat
tests.description: 25 lb, 15 perfect reps, heels flat, neutral spine, knees track correctly

categories.name: Full Body Stability
categories.description: Can every link in the chain work together?
categories.goalDescription: Full body integration - proving the body is prepared for resistance training and complex movement patterns.

tests.name: Deep Squat
tests.description: 20 perfect bodyweight squats with proper alignment

tests.name: Push-Up
tests.description: 15 perfect push-ups (or elevated if needed)

tests.name: Dead Hang
tests.description: 30-second dead hang from pull-up bar

tests.name: Scapular Pull-Ups
tests.description: 10 scapular pull-ups with proper form

tests.name: Split Squat
tests.description: 15 reps each side with proper knee tracking

tests.name: Farmer Carry (Loaded Circuit)
tests.description: 60 seconds, 25% bodyweight each hand, perfect posture

tests.name: Suitcase Carry (Loaded Circuit)
tests.description: 60 seconds, 25% bodyweight one side

tests.name: Overhead Carry
tests.description: 60 seconds overhead without lumbar extension

tests.name: Bottom-Up Kettlebell Hold
tests.description: Without compensation, 20 seconds each arm

tests.name: Turkish Get-Up
tests.description: 10 lb kettlebell, 3 reps each side, perfect form

tests.name: Walking Lunge
tests.description: 20 steps with perfect alignment and balance

tests.name: Single-Leg Hop
tests.description: Stick landing, 10 reps each leg, perfect balance

tests.name: Bear Crawl
tests.description: 30 meters with proper form and control

tests.name: Overhead Reach
tests.description: Arms fully overhead without lumbar extension
